title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode4 Natural Talent

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where's Tsukasa?
It's been a while since Nene went back to practice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
He is a little late.
As much as I'd like to go find him, it's nearly time for us to go visit the production team...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it's so nice of them to allow us to see the directing and production teams at work. It's not every day that you get to do this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's watch and learn as much as we can!!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Ah, are you here to observe the production team?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Mr. Kato!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we're here to learn as much as we can from them. By the way... Is Tsukasa with you?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Hm? Tenma?
I thought he rejoined you after speaking with me. If I see him, I'll let him know that you're looking for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also, if no trouble...
Would you mind if I asked you a question?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Yes, ask away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: About Reki Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why is he...not playing the lead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, everyone here is a talented actor in their own right. However, Bakuno is on a completely different level...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on his skills and abilities, I imagine that he'd do a tremendous job as the protagonist, Kishi. The fact that he wasn't picked left me wondering...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
I'm constantly asking myself the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I was originally going to have him play Kishi. But...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He didn't want to.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He was absolutely against it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He...didn't want the lead part?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I-If you insist...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Reki Bakuno...
The way he plays his character... I'm having trouble looking away.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I could learn to do the same... No, learning even just a little bit about how he does this would be huge.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He's had his face buried in his script over in that corner for a while now. I don't wanna interrupt him...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I feel like we have similar personalities... I should be doing what I can if I really want to improve my acting skills...!)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: ...is what I believe...but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Huh? I-Is he ignoring me...?
No... He must've not heard me.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!!
Bakunooooooooo!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene & Reki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Um... Did someone just call my...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Reki Bakunooooooooo!!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: W-Wah!!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
H-Huh?
Oh, you're from Wonderlands×Showtime, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, please allow me to reintroduce myself! My name is Tsukasa Tenma! Tenma, written as “soaring pegasus”!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ugh! Will you just shut up?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Ah, Nene, you're here. Are Rui and Emu not with you?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: O-Oh, umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They went over to visit the directing and production teams! More importantly, why'd you cut in front of me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I cut in front of you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I was trying to talk to Bakuno first!
I wanted to ask how he's able to sound so convincing.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Huh? S-So...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that means our goals are aligned!
I also came over to ask him the same thing! Let us see what he has to say together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, Bakuno!
Please tell us how you do it...!!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: U-Uhh... The thing is...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: B-Before I answer, I would appreciate it very much if you could both first...lower your voices...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We're really sorry.
We didn't mean to get so worked up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please forgive us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He just asked you to lower your voice...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Haha... I'm okay with this volume...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
So, umm...
You're here to ask about my acting...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like to learn to make my character feel more human and give my acting more depth just like you! Please, tell me how!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: More human...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Honestly... I just go based on feeling...
I don't know how else to explain it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: An image usually forms in my head while I'm reading a script. I get a sense of who the character might be.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Then, it's just a matter of putting that into practice... Mr. Kato gives me directions, I adjust, rinse and repeat... That's all, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-That's all?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes...
I rehearse the same way as the others. I don't really do anything all that special...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Nothing special...?
But the way he performs...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This must be what natural talent looks like...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, I need to keep asking!
There may still be some clues that remain hidden!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but if you don't mind me asking you a few more questions!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
But I don't know if my answers will actually help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm still grasping at straws...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I wish I could be more helpful...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, no... You've done nothing wrong, Bakuno. We still have a lot to learn is all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for taking time out of your schedule to answer our questions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
N-No, it was my pleasure...
I had a lot of fun talking with you two.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's a very nice person...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But... I came out of that conversation empty-handed.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I only have three lines... I can't what my character's feeling... If I plan on having as much presence as Bakuno, then...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Forget it!
If I didn't get my answer this time, that means I just have to keep looking!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm going to do everything in my power to accomplish this task!!)
